headline: French Companies Announce €14.9 Billion in Domestic Industrial Investments
summary: French corporations pledged €14.9 billion across 81 new industrial projects covering health, cosmetics, and biofuels during the national Choose France investment summit.
why: The Choose France summit is France's premier state initiative designed to channel private corporate investment into domestic manufacturing hubs.

impacts.name: France
impacts.why: New industrial capital commitments expand domestic capital expenditure and industrial output.
